name: webx/cta-band
title: WebX: CTA band
description: A closing call-to-action panel with action buttons. Shared between ORST and RoyalSociety — both templates read the identical {eyebrow,heading,body,actions} shape (ORST's own renderer just doesn't use eyebrow). Synced into page.acf.blocks as a "cta-band" block.
